answer_1.quote: Referring Expression Generation (REG, ...) is a controlled set‑up that is well established in NLG research ...

answer_2.quote: To estimate the general generation capabilities of our models we rely on BLEU and CIDEr as established metrics for automatic evaluation.

answer_4.quote: Human judgments were collected from 6 expert annotators, including the first author. Every system was evaluated independently by three annotators, with a Fleiss' Kappa of 0.85... The annotators were instructed to rate only those parts of the expressions that refer to the type of the referential target. All items should be assigned exactly one of the following categories: Adequate / A, Misaligned / M, Omission / O, False / F.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each generated expression for the type description, assigning it to one of the categories: Adequate, Misaligned, Omitted, or False.
